tools.name: list_products
tools.description: All products Denia Print prices online, with the lowest price (excl. IVA, smallest run, cheapest options) and the product page. Use get_product for the options of one.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The options of one product (format, paper, finish, ...), each with its id and label, the quantities, the default choice and the usual delivery time in working days.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: The exact price of a product with the chosen options and quantity, for delivery in Spain: excl. IVA, the IVA (21 %) and the total, plus the prices of the other quantities. Options left out take the default.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request to Denia Print for the user, like the form on the site: the team replies with a written quote, without obligation, and the user gets a confirmation by e-mail with a link to follow it. Only with the user's consent and their real contact details.

tools.name: shop_info
tools.description: Answers to common questions: how to order, proof and payment, payment methods, print files, delivery, pickup in Dénia, languages, the customer account, samples, contact, conditions. Without a topic: all of them.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: The status of an existing order or quote request: progress, expected delivery or pickup, tracking, the proof. Needs the reference (DP-..., in the confirmation e-mail) and the e-mail address (or phone) the order was placed with.

tools.name: send_status_link
tools.description: Mails the link of the order's status page (approve the proof, send the file, pay, write to the team) to the order's own e-mail address. Needs the reference and that e-mail address.

tools.name: message_team
tools.description: Sends a question or change request about an existing order to the team (it lands in the order, the team replies by e-mail). Needs the reference and the order's e-mail address. For something new use request_quote.
